patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Inter (+ Material Symbols Outlined for icons).
Nextkt remaps rounded-full to 12px — use --radius-pill (12px) or --radius-circle (9999px) explicitly.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, name, size, tile, color, style.
<Badge> tone must be one of 'on-sale' | 'primary' | 'ga' | 'vip' | 'tables' | 'sold-out' | 'error' | 'neutral'.
<Badge> variant must be one of 'solid' | 'tint' | 'glass'.
<Badge> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md'.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, tone, variant, caps, size, style.
<Button> variant must be one of 'primary' | 'container' | 'outline' | 'secondary' | 'inverse' | 'glass' | 'link' | 'destructive'.
<Button> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'cta'.
<Card> tone must be one of 'default' | 'low' | 'muted'.
<IconButton> variant must be one of 'ghost' | 'brand' | 'glass' | 'floating'.
<DateChip> variant must be one of 'leaf' | 'glass' | 'plain'.
<DateChip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: month, day, variant, style.
<EventCard> variant must be one of 'featured' | 'discovery' | 'directory' | 'poster'.
<EventCard> badgeTone must be one of 'on-sale' | 'primary' | 'vip' | 'sold-out'.
<EventCard> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, title, image, badge, badgeTone, eyebrow, summary, venue, city, price, month, day, stock, cta, onClick, style.
<EventRow> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, venue, city, price, month, day, favorite, last, onClick, style.
<SectionHeader> size must be one of 'lg' | 'md' | 'eyebrow'.
<SectionHeader> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, subtitle, action, onAction, size, style.
<StatCard> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, value, label, sub, onClick, style.
<TicketTier> tone must be one of 'ga' | 'vip' | 'tables'.
<TicketTier> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: badge, tone, name, price, subtitle, available, soldOut, qty, max, onChange, style.
<MobileAppBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: logoSrc, cartCount, onMenu, onCart, onLogo, style.
<MobileTabBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: items, value, onChange, safeArea, style.
<NavItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, label, active, danger, onClick, style.
<Tabs> variant must be one of 'nav' | 'underline' | 'chips' | 'segmented'.
<Tabs> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tabs, value, onChange, variant, style.
